name: Landmark 81
summary: Riverside tower in the skyline: look up the full shaft from the bank, with the lower blocks beside it. The night frame lights the same shaft. Pair the look with the walk at Bạch Đằng when you want the river in the same hour. The ride out from Nguyễn Huệ is by taxi or ride-hail.
getThere: By taxi or ride-hail from Nguyễn Huệ.
heroCaption: Landmark 81 from the riverbank, the full shaft and the lower blocks
body: Landmark 81 is the tall shaft in the riverside skyline, with Bitexco and Ba Son Bridge among the city’s modern icons. The photograph is the whole tower from the bank, with the lower blocks beside it and the river in front.

The second photograph is the same shaft after dark, lit above the neighboring blocks and the trees. Come for that skyline from the bank, on the same day as the walk at Bạch Đằng if the river is the point.

figures.caption: The same tower after dark, lit above the neighboring blocks
figures.alt: Landmark 81 at night above the riverside blocks

gettingThere: The tower stands on the river, north of the walkable center. Go by taxi or ride-hail from Nguyễn Huệ or from Bạch Đằng.

legs.heading: From Bạch Đằng
legs.body: The quay is the river walk in the center. The tower is farther up the bank.
